---
title: "HPA_Quarto"
author: "Josh Liu"
---
How do the summed counts of regionally elevated genes across the
cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus compare
between humans, pigs and mice?
```{r}
# Human
sum(180, 83, 57, 110)

# Pig
sum(109, 157, 31, 45)

# Mouse
sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
```
Humans had the highest summed count, with 430, compared with
398 in mice and 342 in pigs.
